summary: Iteration 3 full-stack validation completed. All requested core workflows passed end-to-end: super-admin/tenant login, tenant card metadata, clone and purge, PDF live preview for kabul/teslim, subscription expiry rejection and restoration, audit filtering/grouping/refresh, create/edit item-select reset, tenant/order CRUD, and real-order PDF. Backend edge/security regression found 2 failures; mobile audit layout is clipped.

critical.issue: Invalid user-supplied regex reaches MongoDB and returns HTTP 500 (OperationFailure: missing terminating ]). Filter input is not escaped or validated.
Credentialed CORS preflight still returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * instead of the explicit public frontend origin; untrusted origins are therefore not rejected as required.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport the records table is ~832px wide, extends beyond the viewport, and has no horizontal-scroll ancestor; user/action/entity columns are clipped by Layout's overflow-x-hidden.

issues: Date fields use native browser <input type='date'> pickers rather than the app's shadcn calendar/date-picker component.
Clone and PDF preview dialogs emit Radix accessibility warnings because DialogContent has no DialogDescription/aria-describedby.

action_items: Escape audit text filters with re.escape (literal substring matching) or validate regex syntax and return a controlled 400; never let malformed filters reach MongoDB as raw regex.
Configure explicit trusted CORS origins at both FastAPI and ingress; remove wildcard CORS when credentials are enabled.
Wrap the audit records table in overflow-x-auto or provide a responsive mobile card/column-priority layout.
Reset trial_ends_at and subscription_ends_at when cloning, or explicitly require new values, so cloning an expired tenant does not create an immediately blocked tenant.
Add DialogDescription to clone/PDF dialogs and use the shared shadcn date picker.
Retest the two backend failures and mobile audit layout after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: clone_tenant claims to reset subscription/active state but only overrides is_active and plan; it inherits trial_ends_at and subscription_ends_at from the source.
Tenant cloning performs tenant insert, catalog loops, user insert, and audit insert without a MongoDB transaction; mid-flow failure can leave a partial tenant/catalog without an admin.
Audit filters pass raw user strings into Mongo $regex. Besides malformed-regex 500s, this exposes avoidable regex performance/ReDoS risk; use escaped literal matching.
Subscription validity is checked only during login. Existing cookie/bearer sessions continue to authorize after expiry until the token expires; malformed date strings are silently ignored.

Admin routes are only authentication-protected in App.js, not role-protected; a tenant user can navigate directly to them and receive indefinite loading/empty states after backend 403s because loaders do not render errors.
Several new interactive/critical controls lack data-testid attributes, including PDF Yenile/Kapat, audit Temizle, admin tabs, and tenant plan/end-date badges.
server.py is now about 1,880 lines and combines auth, tenant administration, cloning, audit, business CRUD, PDF, storage, and seeding; split it into focused routers/services.

success_rate.backend: 81.8% (9/11 tests passed; every requested core functional API flow passed, with invalid audit regex and CORS security checks failing)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested desktop E2E flows passed; one additional mobile audit responsiveness check failed)

Demo tenant was intentionally left active on Pro with trial_ends_at and subscription_ends_at set to 2030-01-01, and tenant login was reverified.
test_credentials: Used both credential sections from /app/memory/test_credentials.md successfully. /app/auth_testing.md is absent. bcrypt $2b$, HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=None cookies, five-failure lockout, and seed password reconciliation passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final iteration-3 pytest is stable at 9 passed/2 failed. Core requested UI workflows all pass. UI clone TEST_I3 UI Clone 1786964000 was deleted. Demo subscription is restored and tenant admin login works. Recheck malformed audit filters, public preflight headers, and AdminAuditLogs at 390x844 after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: Audit action/user filters are inserted directly into MongoDB $regex; '[' triggers pymongo OperationFailure code 51091 and FastAPI returns 500. CORS wildcard persists because backend CORS_ORIGINS is '*' and/or ingress overrides preflight. AdminAuditLogs renders a multi-column table without an overflow wrapper while Layout hides horizontal overflow.
